subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should OpenClaw change the subagent bootstrap contract to expose MiniMax Token Plan skill bundles, or keep the AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md boundary and only fix live-proven provider/media defects?
rationale: Source shows the current boundary is intentional and documented, while the reported Token Plan endpoint failure needs live API proof before changing provider routing.

options.title: Split provider bugs from skill inheritance
options.body: Live-test MiniMax Token Plan image/media endpoints, fix only confirmed provider or wait-path defects, and route office-generation skill bundles through explicit skill/plugin surfaces.

options.title: Approve broader subagent skill inheritance
options.body: Allow a designed subagent skill-loading mechanism, accepting the context-boundary and compatibility work it requires.

options.title: Document the mmx workaround only
options.body: Keep runtime behavior unchanged and add clearer docs for using the external mmx CLI in subagents, leaving automation less discoverable.

recommendation.title: Split provider bugs from skill inheritance
recommendation.body: Live-test MiniMax Token Plan image/media endpoints, fix only confirmed provider or wait-path defects, and route office-generation skill bundles through explicit skill/plugin surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Eva introduced the current subagent bootstrap boundary, which is the product contract at the center of the decision.
